career_ladder.note: Career progression in Maharashtra Police from direct-entry Police Constable (Shipai) through non-gazetted and subordinate officer ranks. exam_scheme.note: Recruitment is conducted under the Maharashtra Police Constable (Recruitment) Rules, 2011 (amended 2021/2022). Selection is a two-stage process: Stage 1 is the Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET - 50 marks for General and Driver constables; 100 marks for SRPF Armed Police Constables). Candidates scoring minimum 50% marks (25 out of 50) are shortlisted in a 1:10 ratio based on merit for Stage 2: Written Examination (100 marks, 90 minutes, conducted statewide on a single day). Driver candidates must additionally pass a 50-mark qualifying driving skill test (minimum 40% required). Final merit is compiled from Physical Test + Written Examination marks (Total 150 marks for General Constable; 200 marks for SRPF). Pursuant to Home Department Order dated 20.10.2022, NCC 'C' certificate holders are awarded 5% bonus marks (5 marks).

stages.stage_name: Stage 1 — Physical Standard Test (PST) & Physical Efficiency Test (PET)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 50% (25 marks out of 50 required to qualify for 1:10 shortlisting for Written Exam)

papers.qualifying_threshold: 40% (minimum 40 marks out of 100 mandatory to be eligible for final merit selection)

financial_package.note: Placed in Pay Level S-6 under the Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019 (implementing Maharashtra 7th Pay Commission vide Government Resolution No. RPS-2019/CR-1/Services-9 dated 01-01-2019). Entry basic pay is ₹21,700 in the pay band ₹21,700 – ₹69,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: Maharashtra Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2019, Pay Matrix Level S-6 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100)
financial_package.estimate_note: Basic pay ₹21,700 in Pay Level S-6 (₹21,700 - ₹69,100). Gross range computed with 58% DA (₹12,586) and HRA ranging from 9% in Z-class rural/district postings (₹1,953) to 27% in X-class cities like Mumbai and Pune (₹5,859), plus special police allowance, conveyance/transport allowance, uniform kit and monthly washing allowances. In-hand estimate factors in standard 10% NPS deduction (₹3,429), state insurance/GIS (₹200), and Maharashtra professional tax (₹200). In addition, Maharashtra Police personnel receive one extra month's basic pay (13th month salary compensation) annually in lieu of working on gazetted public holidays.
official_perks: Government police quarters or House Rent Allowance (HRA up to 27% in X-class cities like Mumbai and Pune)
Annual 13th month salary compensation (equivalent to 30/45 days extra basic pay per year for working on weekly offs and public holidays)
Police uniform allowance, kit maintenance allowance, and monthly washing allowance (धुलाई भत्ता)
Special Police Duty Allowance and Conveyance / Transport Allowance
Comprehensive medical coverage under Maharashtra State Government Employees Health Scheme and Police Welfare Fund
Subsidized groceries and provisions through Maharashtra Police Canteen (पोलीस कॅन्टीन) network
Naxal/Disturbed Area Special Allowance (special compensatory hardship allowance for postings in Gadchiroli and Gondia districts)

competition_benchmarks.note: Maharashtra Police conducts periodic mass recruitments across police commissionerates, district police units, SRPF battalions, and prison units. The 2024-2025 mega-recruitment advertised 17,471 vacancies, attracting over 17.76 lakh applicants. The previous 2022-2023 mega-drive advertised 18,331 vacancies and received over 18.28 lakh applications. Physical tests are held first with a 1:10 shortlisting ratio for the written exam.
